sys_script_include.description: Reusable accessor over the ClaimEase system properties. Owns the documented threshold boundary rule so approval routing and duplicate detection always agree about which claims are small.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseConfig

sys_script_include.description: Parses the composite currency value CODE;amount and converts it to the configured base currency, writing the result to amount_usd. Fails loudly when no exchange rate is available.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseCurrency

sys_script_include.description: Server-only duplicate validation implementing the rolling-window rule for small claims, plus the per-employee submission mutex. Reusable from the record producer, business rules, the flow and ATF tests.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck

sys_script_include.description: Named mutex for ClaimEase, enforced by a UNIQUE database index on the lock key so two simultaneous acquires cannot both succeed. Internal helper used by ClaimEaseDuplicateCheck.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseLock

sys_script_include.description: Issues reimbursement claim numbers (CLM0001000, ...) from the sys_number counter for the claim table. Replaces the global getNextObjNumberPadded default, which a scoped application cannot call.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseNumber

sys_script_include.description: Server-side claim validation shared by the record producer and the business rules. Also resolves the approving manager with a fallback group, and owns the approval-field authorisation checks.
sys_script_include.name: ClaimEaseValidator
